scope: S13 Company identity update, website relationship review, rollback, and causal rediscovery

implementation.history: CompanyWebsiteRevision is append-only; CompanyWebsiteHead advances monotonically
implementation.atomic_change: Company version/configuration fence, immutable website revision, human review Work, head, receipt, and two audit events commit together
implementation.production_source_policy: existing Sources, Assignments, Checkpoints, Jobs, and observations are not rewritten or automatically disabled
implementation.rollback: company.website.rollback references only the current revision, restores its immutable previous URL, and appends a new revision and review Work
implementation.rediscovery: new Source Discovery records the current website revision and uses its review Work as cause_work_id; the Repository revalidates the current head transactionally
implementation.old_attempt_policy: website changes advance Company configuration_version, so old discovery results are fenced and their bounded Artifacts are retained as rejected evidence

contract_observation.website_update_replay: one stable Company, revision, review Work, head, receipt, and response
contract_observation.rollback_replay: versions remain monotonic and repeated delivery returns the original response
contract_observation.stale_rollback: a non-current revision is rejected without Company, revision, Work, receipt, or event residue
contract_observation.concurrent_update: two simultaneous commands against Company version 1 converge to one success and one version conflict, with exactly one complete website fact set
contract_observation.rediscovery_lineage: a superseded review Work is rejected; the current revision and review Work are durably linked to the accepted discovery
contract_observation.server_restart: public update/get/rollback/rediscovery journey survives Atoll Server restart and preserves the pre-existing Source unchanged

verification.core_boundary: pass from a94d2b8d; no protocol/runtime/lib/platform/registry changes

acceptance.remaining_production_gate: none specific to S13; global S12/S25/P9 deployment gates remain
